item.title: FirsTier Bank opens Boulder branch, names market president
Larimer, Boulder post lowest local unemployment rates
item.description: Colorado's seasonally adjusted unemployment rate fell one-tenth of a percentage point from November to December, ending 2025 at 3.8%.

item.title: Asking Eric: Boyfriend says ‘I love you’ but won’t commit
item.description: In this edition of Asking Eric, a woman in her 30s is confused by a man who says "I love you" but won't commit to a title. Meanwhile, a woman in her late 70s struggles with a profound sense of isolation despite being active in her community and family.

item.title: Your Daily Horoscope for January 29, 2026
item.description: our Thursday, January 29, 2026, daily horoscope advises a "wait and see" approach due to below-zero Universal scores. From career calm for Libra to rediscovering gifts for Aquarius, find out how to navigate the day. Plus, celebrate "Tracker" star Justin Hartley's birthday.

item.title: Xcel must consider citizens with special needs; keep supporting BIFF; our emperor has no clothes (Letters)
item.description: I am a 95-year-old professional woman who lives alone and requires nightly oxygen and has mobility problems. I had a very difficult time during the Xcel outage that lasted almost three days. Although I wore five layers of clothing and a blanket over my legs, my house without heat was too cold for me. After three nights without oxygen and adequate food, I became somewhat confused.

item.title: Unmentioned but present, Trump is a common denominator in efforts to strengthen Asia-Europe ties
item.description: Trump's shaking up of the global order is worrying friends and foes and driving them closer.

item.title: Bondi’s letter to Minnesota deserves scorn. But it’s also a warning we can’t ignore. (Editorial)
item.description: Pam Bondi has really distinguished herself this time. The U.S. attorney general who famously botched the handling of the Jeffrey Epstein files has written a letter to Minnesota’s governor — on Saturday, the same day nurse Alex Pretti was shot dead by immigration agents — in what can only be interpreted as an extortion attempt.

item.title: Mittelman: Apartheid politics in the United States
item.description: The United States is veering toward apartheid politics, the system of institutionalized racism in South Africa from 1948 until it crumbled in 1994. Parallels to the U.S. during the Trump years are unnerving. Now is the time for Americans to reset the course.

item.title: US appeals court says Noem’s decision to end protections for Venezuelans in US was illegal
item.description: The decision will not have any immediate practical effect after the Supreme Court in October allowed Noem’s decision to take effect pending a final decision by the justices.

item.title: New videos show Alex Pretti scuffle with federal officers in Minneapolis 11 days before his death
item.description: The new videos have rekindled the national debate about the death of Pretti.
